title: synchronized-lightweight-auth-profiles-and-stream-mapper-facade-across-py-ts-go
author: Nora Patel
description: Context: Teams reported small but recurring inconsistencies in how the three SDKs handled credential refresh, retry windows and generator/async stream ergonomics. This patch harmonizes a minimal, opt-in "lightweight auth profile" (refresh/ttl/backoff hints) across Python/TypeScript/Go SDK bindings and introduces a small StreamMapper facade that gives language idiomatic generator/async-iterator views while preserving a single canonical retry-and-auth contract in the runtime. Motivation: reduce customer confusion, simplify SDK maintenance, and enable coordinated version bumps without changing server-side contracts. What changed: added a shared auth profile schema (ttl, refresh_margin_ms, backoff_profile_name) surfaced as a small, documented client option in each SDK; introduced StreamMapper adapters (py: generator-based, ts: async iterable + for-await, go: channel iterator helper) plus examples; tightened retry-window semantics so the runtime receives a single canonical TTL hint and clients get consistent reauth events; bumped SDK package versions (py 1.11.0, ts 1.28.0, go 1.8.0) and updated changelogs. Testing: unit + integration test matrix for all three SDKs (local runtime mock + real e2e on staging), added lightweight golden tests for auth telemetry keys. Rollout: feature guarded by client opt-in flag; default behavior is unchanged. Related: closes ENG-3147, pairs with runtime PR #4921 for synthesis telemetry. Backwards compatibility: opt-in only; no forced behavior change. See changed files for implementation notes and small cross-SDK examples.
